command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=19999bde451f068ee503d4b7c9a0a91712709c2a; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; ACTIVE="${HOME}/esp/esp-idf"; EXTRA="${HOME}/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4"; test -d "$ACTIVE/.git"; ACTIVE_COMMIT="$(git -C "$ACTIVE" rev-parse HEAD)"; test "$(git -C "$ACTIVE" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)" = 'v5.5.4'; if [[ -e "$EXTRA" ]]; then test -d "$EXTRA/.git"; ORIGIN="$(git -C "$EXTRA" remote get-url origin)"; case "$ORIGIN" in https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf.git|git@github.com:espressif/esp-idf.git) ;; *) echo "Refusing to remove unexpected ESP-IDF origin: $ORIGIN" >&2; exit 1;; esac; test -z "$(git -C "$EXTRA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; test "$(git -C "$EXTRA" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)" = 'v5.5.4'; test "$(git -C "$EXTRA" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$ACTIVE_COMMIT"; rm -rf "$EXTRA"; fi; printf 'ACTIVE_IDF_COMMIT=%s\n' "$ACTIVE_COMMIT"; find "${HOME}/esp" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'esp-idf*' -print | sort
